name: Inside the NFL
description: The hardest-hitting team of analysts in sports delivers expert insight, exclusive commentary and special on and off the field features you won't find anywhere else. Inside the NFL brings you the sights, sounds and spectacle of the NFL in all its glory, including exciting player profiles, interviews, and intense, moment-by-moment game footage. Every team. Every game. Every week.

videos.title: Week 1
videos.overview: James Brown, Cris Collinsworth, Phil Simms and Warren Sapp return to preview the first week of the 2009-2010 season beginning with the Tennessee Titans vs. Pittsburgh Steelers Thursday September 10th. Joined by Bill Cowher for the opening episode, the cast looks over the big stories in the offseason, looks at how Twitter has made an impact in the NFL, looks over the 1st year head-coaches, and evaluates how they will fare this season. Plus the cast looks ahead to Week 1 with their Pick Six segment, and concludes the show by remembering the late Harry Kalas, and introduces the new voice of Inside the NFL, Scott Graham.

videos.title: Week 2
videos.overview: The cast in this episode talks about all the Week 1 highlights, what's happened with Jake Delhomme, how the Donovan McNabb injury will hurt the Eagles, the top 5 quarterbacks in football, the end of the Wildcat era, and the fear that nearly 50 games could be blacked out due to failure of selling out.

videos.title: Preseason
videos.overview: Season 34 kicks off with Cris, Phil, JB and Warren.

JB, Phil, Cris and Warren talk about the re-emergence of the New England Patriots, the debacle in Dallas causing the Cowboys their 1st game, Calvin Johnson's catch or no catch, and looking forward to week 2 whether we'll see more of Michael Vick and perhaps the last of Tom Cable. Plus Texans running back Arian Foster talks about his Week 1 performance and how threatening the Texans are. That and "You Cannot Be Serious", along with Week 1 highlights, on Inside the NFL.

videos.title: 2016 Season Preview
videos.overview: Host James Brown and analysts Phil Simms, Boomer Esiason, Brandon Marshall and Adam Schein discuss the hot topics going into the new season: QBs, athletes and social responsibility plus, Bronco Von Miller.

videos.title: 2016 Week 1
videos.overview: Host James Brown and expert analysts Phil Simms, Boomer Esiason and Hall of Famer Michael Irvin discuss Cam Newton's treatment, the magic of the Belichick-Brady relationship plus, the next gen of QBs.

videos.title: 2016 Week 2
videos.overview: Host James Brown and expert analyst Boomer Esiason, Hall of Famer Michael Irvin and NY Jet Brandon Marshall discuss if it's too soon for 0-2 teams to start panicking and the pressures of playing injured.

videos.title: 2016 Week 3
videos.overview: Host James Brown and expert analysts Boomer Esiason, Michael Irvin and NY Jet Brandon Marshall discuss if Patriots coach Bill Belichick is the greatest of all time, plus the new generation of rookie QBs.

videos.title: 2018 Season Preview
videos.overview: This week on INSIDE THE NFL, host James Brown plus analysts Phil Simms, Boomer Esiason, Ray Lewis and guest analyst Steve Smith Sr. discuss the biggest stories from the offseason and preview what's ahead in week 1. Season premiere.

videos.title: 2018 Week 1
videos.overview: This week on INSIDE THE NFL, Malcolm Jenkins joins the cast to discuss the Eagles’ opening week win over the Atlanta Falcons. Also featured is the Green Bay Packers’ thrilling comeback win over the Chicago Bears.

videos.title: 2018 Week 2
videos.overview: This week on INSIDE THE NFL, it's the Pittsburgh Steelers and the ongoing drama surrounding the team, how the rules of the game have changed the new wave of defenders, and the success of Florida teams with a combined 6-0 record.

videos.title: 2018 Week 3
videos.overview: This week on Inside the NFL, the crew discusses historically prominent franchises that are struggling in the early season, young quarterbacks who are having an impact early in their careers, and the hot start of the L.A. Rams.

videos.title: 2018 Week 4
videos.overview: This week on Inside the NFL, discussions include the increase in passing offense around the league, under-appreciated teams including the Tennessee Titans and Cincinnati Bengals, and how players are dealing with contract disputes.

videos.title: 2018 Week 5
videos.overview: This week on Inside the NFL, discussions center around the pressure of play-calling, the struggles of NFC East teams—including the drama surrounding the New York Giants—and the business aspect of the National Football League.

videos.title: 2018 Week 6
videos.overview: This week on Inside the NFL: the thrilling game between the Chiefs and Patriots last week, the polar opposite fate of the two New York football teams, and whether or not the Cowboys and Jaguars can make it into the postseason.

videos.title: 2018 Week 7
videos.overview: This week on Inside the NFL: an in-depth breakdown of the Kansas City Chiefs and their high-flying offense plus, the benefits of having a proven back-up quarterback and the all-around importance of the kicking game.

videos.title: 2018 Week 8
videos.overview: This week on INSIDE THE NFL, the team hand out their midseason awards and name their top 10 units using the INSIDE THE NFL 64 ranking system. Plus, they discuss the future of the Cleveland Browns.

videos.title: 2018 Playoffs Week 2
videos.overview: This week on INSIDE THE NFL: the future of the four teams who were eliminated during the Divisional Playoffs and an extensive preview of the AFC and NFC Championship games. Plus, a discussion on the latest developments in the NFL coaching carousel.

videos.title: 2018 Playoffs Week 3
videos.overview: Every team, every game, every week of the football season. Join host James Brown for exclusive game highlights from NFL Films plus, expert analysis, in-depth features and hard-hitting commentary from NFL MVPs Phil Simms and Boomer Esiason, veteran linebacker Ray Lewis and special correspondent Steve Smith, Sr.

videos.title: 2018 Super Bowl Preview
videos.overview: Every team, every game, every week of the football season. Join host James Brown for exclusive game highlights from NFL Films plus, expert analysis, in-depth features and hard-hitting commentary from NFL MVPs Phil Simms and Boomer Esiason, veteran linebacker Ray Lewis and special correspondent Steve Smith, Sr.

videos.title: 2019 Week 5
videos.overview: James Brown and the crew recap Week 5, discussing the improving Panthers and Raiders and the stumbling Cowboys, as well as the leadership and culture of the Washington Redskins. Analysts include Phil Simms, Brandon Marshall, Michael Irvin and Ray Lewis.

videos.title: 2019 Week 7
videos.overview: Analysis of the careers of next-generation quarterbacks. Plus, Buccaneers star Ndamukong Suh shares his experience on how the game has changed in his 10 years. Phil Simms, Brandon Marshall, Michael Irvin and Ray Lewis join host James Brown.

videos.title: 2019 Week 12
videos.overview: James Brown hosts a recap of Week 12, plus discussion of top NFL storylines and newsmakers. Analysts include Phil Simms, Brandon Marshall, Michael Irvin and Ray Lewis.

videos.title: 2019 Playoffs Week 1
videos.overview: James Brown hosts reaction to the four closely-contested Wild Card playoff games, and a preview of the Divisional Round matchups. Analysts include Brandon Marshall, Phil Simms, Ray Lewis and Steve Smith Sr.

videos.title: 2019 Playoffs Week 2
videos.overview: Former pitcher CC Sabathia guests to weigh in on the NFL playoff games, particularly Titans-Ravens, as well as baseball's recent cheating scandal. James Brown hosts alongside Brandon Marshall, Phil Simms, Ray Lewis and Steve Smith Sr.

videos.title: 2019 Playoffs Week 3
videos.overview: Detailed analysis of conference championship games, including what powered the Kansas City Chiefs and San Francisco 49ers to Super Bowl LIV. Plus, a deep dive into the pending NFL collective bargaining agreement

videos.title: 2020 Week 15
videos.overview: James Brown hosts a Week 15 NFL recap, with analysts Brandon Marshall, Phil Simms, Ray Lewis and Michael Irvin.

videos.title: February 7, 2023
videos.overview: Both super bowl teams led their conference in points and yards per game. What will be their keys to success this weekend? Hurdles still faced by black QBs in the league today; Tom Brady's retirement and life after football.

videos.title: 2023 Season Preview
videos.overview: A panel of football experts break down the top storylines of the upcoming 2023 NFL season. Highlights include inside access to team training camps, previously unseen angles of pivotal preseason game action and revealing behind-the-scenes audio direct from the sidelines

videos.title: 2024 Season Preview
videos.overview: The 2024 NFL season kicks off with the INSIDE THE NFL panel of experts setting the stage for the games ahead by combining expert analysis with pivotal game action captured by NFL Films’ legendary cinematographers and exclusive all-access “mic’d up” audio. INSIDE THE NFL is hosted by Emmy® Award-winner Ryan Clark with Bill Belichick, Chad Johnson and Chris Long serving as analysts (#4700). Original airdate August 30, 2024.

videos.title: Week 1
videos.overview: The INSIDE THE NFL panel of experts break down all the exciting highlights from Week 1 of the 2024 NFL season and look ahead to the upcoming weekend’s matchups using pivotal game action captured by NFL Films’ legendary cinematographers and exclusive all-access “mic’d up” audio. INSIDE THE NFL is hosted by Emmy® Award-winner Ryan Clark with Bill Belichick, Chad Johnson and Chris Long serving as analysts (#4701). Original airdate September 13, 2024.
